svg.title: Gibbs ringing of an epicycle chain at the window wrap
svg.desc: Reconstruction of a ramp with 4, 12 and 24 epicycles, and the overshoot against the number of terms kept.
svg.text: Gibbs ringing: a memory ramp rebuilt from K epicycles
z[n] = i (n / 60), mean removed; the periodic extension jumps by -1 at the wrap
time within the window (samples, continued periodically)
Imaginary part of the chain's tip
0.0895 is (Si(pi)/pi - 1/2): the classical Gibbs overshoot as a share of the jump; finite N and the 1/k amplitude ordering change it only slightly.
